default.text: Another one who fell from the sky? You are the third this year. If you are hurt, eat something: a good steak mends more than any potion.

night.text: Another one who fell from the sky? You are the third this year. Sit. Eat. Both of you.

night_food.text: Eat something when you're hurt. A good steak mends more than any potion. And sleep by the oven. Nobody comes looking in a bakery.
